name: 7-Zip
profile: 7-Zip is a file compression software for the Windows operating system.
metadataText:
[PackageName]
7-Zip

[Version]
26.00

[OS]
XP

[InstallerName]
7zip

[URL]
x86: 7zip-{version}.pie (default)
x64: 7zip-x64-{version}.pie
::end

[ProFile]
7-Zip is a file compression software for the Windows operating system.

[DefaultOpen]
7zFM.exe
::end

[Alias]
zip: 7z.exe a -tzip $1 $2
7z: 7z.exe a -t7z $1 $2
gz: 7z.exe a -tgzip $1 $2
xz: 7z.exe a -txz $1 $2
unzip: 7z.exe x $1 -o$2
::end

[Author]
Igor Pavlov.

[Distributor]
Sanakaprix

[PackageSize]
4.14 MB

[Notice]
GNU LGPL with BSD 3-clause and unRAR restrictions.
See LICENSE.txt in software directory.
